ValidationRule.description: SCRUM-442 AC1: A closed Case (IsClosed=true) without a Customer_Satisfaction__c score is hard-blocked at save — on EVERY closing path (console UI, REST/CLI, queue paths SCRUM-421/422, Apex, data import), because a ValidationRule is declarative, not path-dependent. While the Case is open the field stays voluntary (AC3-shape). House: SCRUM-434 Ursache_PflichtBeiGeschlosed (deployed green) — same OR(IsClosed, ISPICKVAL) shape covers the Status-based closing and the IsClosed flag alike.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Bitte wählen eine Kundansatisfaction (1–5) für den geschlossenen Fall, bevor Sie speichern. Solange der Fall offen ist, ist das Feld freiwillig.
